syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of heat processes focused on heat processes in process engineering
Review of fundamentals of thermodynamics and heat transfer (internal energy, enthalpy, entropy, thermodynamic diagrams, heat conduction, heat convection, dimensionless criteria)
Heat exchanger thermal design and rating
Description of evaporators with natural and forced convection
Evaporators with mechanical and thermal recompression of vapours and with heat pump
Description of contact, convective, radiation and spray dryers
Basic properties of dried material (sorption isotherms)
Static and kinetics of drying (drying curve)
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
